description: InfiniBand Subnet Manager & PKey health, bound to live ufm_*/ibl_*/ib_switch_* series in VictoriaMetrics. Panels read via last_over_time(...[6h]) so they render across exporter sweep gaps. A blank tile is a real defect, not an expected state. Bottom row cross-checks against BCM, which needs no IB-plane access.

links.title: 🏠 NVIS Home
links.tooltip: Back to the NVIS Home hub

options.content:
InfiniBand subnet manager & partition policy — fed by the management-plane collectors (ibl_*, ufm_*, ib_switch_info) that read OpenSM / UFM over the switch management network. Those collectors are paused at the moment, so these tiles hold their last retained samples and repopulate as soon as the sweeps resume — the panels are kept in place for that reason.
Switch reachability from the live firmware sweep: IB Switch Fleet  ·  host-side rail telemetry (live, every tray): Rail State & Cabling  ·  Worst Offenders  ·  Port Errors.

panels.description: ibl_up — availability of the IB LLDP / subnet-manager exporter feeding this dashboard.
panels.title: IB-LLDP exporter up

panels.description: ufm_up — availability of the UFM REST exporter (SM host).
panels.title: UFM exporter up

panels.description: ufm_fabric_healthy — UFM's overall fabric health verdict (1 = healthy).
panels.title: UFM fabric healthy

panels.description: ibl_fabric_health_score — composite 0-100 score derived from SM, redundancy, partitions, alarms and switch health.
panels.title: Fabric Health Score

panels.description: ibl_fabric_switches — switches the ib-lldp sweep resolved over LLDP. The 184-switch identity inventory is on the 'Switches by Role' panel below.
panels.title: Switches discovered by LLDP sweep

panels.description: ibl_fabric_hcas — host channel adapters (endpoints) discovered in the fabric.
panels.title: Fabric HCAs

panels.description: ufm_switch_count — switch count as reported by the UFM REST API.
panels.title: UFM-managed switch count

panels.description: ibl_sm_master_count — number of subnet managers currently in MASTER state. Exactly 1 is expected; 0 = no active SM (fabric un-managed), >1 = split-brain.
panels.title: SM Master Count

panels.description: ibl_sm_standby_count — subnet managers in STANDBY state, available for failover.
panels.title: SM Standby Count

panels.description: ibl_sm_has_redundancy — 1 when at least one standby SM is present to protect against master failure.
panels.title: SM Redundancy

panels.description: ibl_sm_disagreements — count of subnet managers reporting conflicting fabric views. Non-zero indicates SM instability / split configuration.
panels.title: SM Disagreements

panels.description: ibl_sm_master_count and ibl_sm_standby_count over time — watch for failover events and drops of the master to 0.
panels.title: SM Master / Standby Counts (trend)

panels.description: ibl_fabric_health_component — per-component contribution (0-100) to the composite fabric health score, including subnet_manager and sm_redundancy.
panels.title: Fabric Health — Component Breakdown

panels.description: ufm_alarms_active — active UFM alarm counts by severity. High-level context for SM/fabric degradation.
panels.title: UFM Active Alarms by Severity

panels.description: ibl_pkey_total — number of partition keys configured in the fabric partition policy.
panels.title: Total PKeys

panels.description: ibl_pkey_inconsistencies — ports whose PKey membership disagrees with the intended partition policy. Should be 0.
panels.title: PKey Inconsistencies

panels.description: ibl_pkey_policy_violations — memberships that violate the configured partition policy (e.g. unauthorized full membership). Should be 0.
panels.title: PKey Policy Violations

panels.description: ibl_pkey — one series per configured PKey (value 1 = present). 0x7fff is the default/management partition.
panels.title: Configured Partition Keys

panels.description: ibl_pkey_inconsistencies and ibl_pkey_policy_violations over time — sustained non-zero values indicate partition drift from policy.
panels.title: PKey Inconsistencies & Violations (trend)

panels.description: ib_switch_info — CORE (spine) vs TOR (leaf) split of the IB switch identity inventory.

links.title: Switches in this role → IB Switch Inventory & Health

panels.title: IB Switches by Role (identity inventory)

panels.description: ibl_switch_ssh_reachable — SSH reachability per switch from the IB-LLDP collector; a proxy for management-plane / SM control access to each switch.

links.title: Switch detail → IB Switch Inventory & Health

panels.title: Switch SSH Reachability (SM management plane)

panels.title: Subnet Manager / UFM exporter log (Loki)
